result.prior_version_note: The documents give only earlier relocation amounts, not when the just-cause requirement itself began. For notices served 3/01/25–2/28/26, § 37.9C relocation was $8,062.00 per tenant, $24,184.00 maximum per unit, plus $5,375.00 for each elderly (60+) or disabled tenant or household with minor children. Ellis Act relocation for that period was $10,863.45 per tenant, $32,590.33 maximum per unit, plus $7,278.67 for each elderly (62+) or disabled tenant. The archive's earliest rows (8/10/06 for § 37.9C and 3/01/06 for Ellis Act) are only the start of the rate history, not enactment dates.
